generators.definition: The compact-energy generator denoted D in Papers VII-VIII and in the E/A/L residual module.
generators.domain: real conformal cylinder together with the declared positive-frequency residual representation
relations: represented geometrically by cylinder time translation H_ESU in the real-cylinder charge audit
identified with the radial grading only in the declared radial-quantization continuation
pushes to (P_0+K_0)/2 under the stated real Penrose map
does not preserve a fixed Minkowski null boundary

generators.definition: Real Lorentzian Minkowski dilation t partial_t + r partial_r.
relations: is tangent to null infinity and restricts to u partial_u
is not Minkowski time translation P_0
agrees with the radial grading only after the declared Cayley/Wick continuation

generators.definition: Compact radial-quantization grading used in the residual representation.
relations: must not be substituted for the real Penrose push-forward of H_ESU without the analytic continuation

generators.definition: Real Minkowski time translation, restricting to Bondi retarded-time translation partial_u.
relations: its ADM/Bondi charge does not compute the charge of D_M or H_ESU

fail_closed_rule: A charge, Cartan, causal, interaction, or quantum result may not be transported between generator_id values without an explicit intertwiner preserving the declared phase space and boundary data.
